verdict.rationale: All evidence is vendor documentation (Anthropic's own docs, pricing, system cards) or community sentiment/anecdotes about model performance in HN threads; nothing in the pack references independent third-party evaluations, benchmarks, or leaderboards (e.g., LMSYS/Chatbot Arena, HELM, independent benchmark suites) that would let a founder cross-check Anthropic's own claims. missing for 10: any citation to independent leaderboard rankings, third-party benchmark results, or academic/press evaluations of Claude models.
